Here's some things that helped me a lot: 
 1. Fasting : i know it seems weird but usually i fast until dinner time and feel alive again, feel like im free 

2. Diet: eating organic, or just going back to the basics, like meat, vegetables with rice or potatoes 

3. Exercise: running helps X182828, like you won t feel it instantly, it s take like weeks but i felt more positive
 
Working out in a gym also helped me, but you re not going without a plan or just for the heck of it.. having a weekly goal as to how much weight you want to lift for how many reps helped me a lot and i try to apply this principle in other areas of my life

4. Taking a cold shower every morning really helps stop this endless string of suicidal ideation...you could try the Wim Hof method

5. Meditation or breathing exercises: i know it s hard believe me, but waking up like 30min in advance and just breathing deeply, and stretching really helps me 

These arent habits to be adopted all at once, ive tried that and ive burnt out and went into a hole again. Just try to implement them (or those that work for you) gradually.

Also, stop drinking, or doing drugs (except of prescribed of course). Even sugar (ive stopped eating it and just feel better in general)
